description: Frozen allowlist of first-party Wasm plugin and native add-on OCI digests published before the cutover release, the first release whose signer attaches transparency-log receipts. These digests verify with the release key alone; every other first-party digest requires a receipt. Never regenerate or extend this file once receipt-bearing releases exist (openspec/changes/restore-signature-tlog-receipts, design.md Decision 9).
